text:
Renee (eng-ml): Quick postmortem follow-up. We keep seeing the KV eviction pattern show up in rollouts. We need a coordinated set of eval additions (regression matrix, promptset, load profiles, chaos drill) and clear owners. Who takes what?
Omar (eng-sre): I can take the chaos drill + runbook edits. Plan: safe staging drill that ramps memory pressure and triggers partial KV eviction, plus explicit abort guards. Target: next Wed 10:00. Need a small driver artifact and the expected alerting thresholds.
Lina (eng-platform): Ill own infra + CI: ephemeral staging cluster provisioning and a nightly job that runs the new sweep matrix. I'll also add a lightweight PR smoke. STG ticket will be created.
Ben (eng-ml): I'll own regression tests + promptset. Proposed matrix: seq_len=[128,512,2048], batch=[1,8,32], kernel=[fp16,int8], cache=[cold,warm], rounding=[nearest,stochastic]. ETA: PR by EOD Friday.
Renee (eng-ml): Please add an edge promptset with long cross-references, repeated short tokens, and burst-write traces we used in the incident. Link the promptset in the tracker and include a small README.
Ben (eng-ml): Example runner command I'll put in the PR: `./ci/run_case --case=burst_write --seq=2048 --kernel=int8 --check-fallback --repeat=3`
Omar (eng-sre): For the chaos driver I need `scripts/induce_mem_ramp --pct_start=60 --pct_end=95 --duration=120 --safe` and abort if sustained error_rate > 0.7% or infra quota > 85%. I'll add triage signals: kv_eviction_rate, cache_eviction_rate, runtime.kernel_fallback_count, p95 latency.
Lina (eng-platform): CI gating: PR smoke = seq=128,batch=1,kernel=int8; nightly = full sweep across matrix. I'll add a Jenkins job `nightly/eviction-hardening` and a dashboard tile. Will post job URL and creds in the tracker.
Renee (eng-ml): Owners summary I'll add to the postmortem tracker: Ben=regression+promptset (Fri), Omar=chaos+runbook (Wed), Lina=infra+CI (Tue). Pass criteria: 48h of nightly runs with no new eviction regressions and p95 within 12% of baseline.
Ben (eng-ml): One risk: quantization QAT and rounding modes shift memory usage. I'll include `--qat=true|false` and rounding axes in the matrix and mark those as higher risk in the README.
Omar (eng-sre): I'll also add a short detection rule in runbook: if `runtime.kernel_fallback_count{kernel=\"int8\"} > 3` within 15m, escalate to SRE on-call and run immediate mitigation checklist.
SignalBot: Postmortem updated: https://redwood/pm/eviction-hardening  3 action_items assigned.
Lina (eng-platform): Cluster provisioning ticket STG-7112 created and CI job scaffolded. I'll paste the job URL and ephemeral creds in the tracker.
Ben (eng-ml): Draft PR uploaded with tests and promptset, linking example logs and a README: https://redwood/pr/eviction-hardening-tests. Requesting reviews from Renee + Omar.
Omar (eng-sre): Scheduled chaos drill Wed 10:00am, tagging on-call. I'll post the driver artifact link and a short step-by-step drill runbook in the PR.
Renee (eng-ml): Thanks all. Please paste this thread ts + PR links into the tracker and mark items as "in progress." We'll reconvene in Monday standup to confirm PR status and overnight canary results. Close items after 48h stable nightlies.
Ben (eng-ml): Noted. I'll add the int8 matrix and a small script to parse fallback logs: `tools/parse_fallback_logs --since=24h`
Lina (eng-platform): If anyone needs more staging time or capacity, ping me. Otherwise I'll aim to have infra + jobs ready by Tue midday.
Renee (eng-ml): Good. Minor add: add an experiment column in the tracker for "rolling canary" vs "full nightlies" so we can stage rollout policies after fixes.
Omar (eng-sre): Agreed. Also adding an abort flow for the drill runner: immediate rollback if error_rate > 1% or disk IO >= 90%.
notes: thread contains owner assignments, commands, and infra tickets
